name: eq.catalog_rebuild.v1
doc: Comparison conditions for the catalog-rebuild workflow family: derive a building QA catalog from a raw hero-qa/1 extract. Frozen before any pair is measured. Changing any field creates a new contract version and invalidates pairs measured under this one.
heldConstant: the raw extract bytes (sha256 pinned in the pilot manifest)
the graded predicate set and tolerances (benchmarks/pilot/catalog/checker.py)
the tools available to the agent (file read/write, Python)
no access to the original workbook, qa-data, photos or builder for either arm
permittedDifferences: the assisted arm's additional step 0 (read the steering files and structure work through the ontology)
whether the arm's working directory is the ontology repository
the arm's intermediate files, scripts and ontology records
invalidatingDifferences: an arm that saw the original workbook, hero-qa-data.json, photos or build_sheet.mjs
an arm that saw the other arm's output or the oracle
a relaxed graded predicate set on either side
a different model or effort between the arms of one pair
an arm run from a directory where the ontology's CLAUDE.md auto-loads without being an explicit plan step

evidenceStandard.note: The subagent transcript's per-request usage blocks, parsed by benchmarks/pilot/catalog/transcript_usage.py. The agent's own statements about its usage are caller assertions and inadmissible.
The checker's grading receipt against the independently computed oracle.

failureRecoveryPolicy: a failed arm stays in the cohort with its full cost; the pair is inadmissible for the leverage numerator and is reported as such; nothing is re-run to obtain acceptance
cacheStratumNote: Every subagent starts with a fresh context. Prompt-cache reads still occur on shared system-prompt prefixes; they are measured under VENDOR_CACHE_READ_INPUT_TOKENS and reported separately, never hidden inside a total.
tokenAccountingBasis: anthropic messages-api usage, observed-2026-09-10 layout: input_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens and cache_read_input_tokens are DISJOINT_ADDITIVE; thinking_tokens is a SUBSET_OF_OUTPUT. One measurement per provider requestId.

costBases.context_tokens: VENDOR_INPUT_TOKENS + VENDOR_CACHE_CREATION_INPUT_TOKENS + VENDOR_CACHE_READ_INPUT_TOKENS -- everything the model processed as input
costBases.output_tokens: VENDOR_OUTPUT_TOKENS -- everything the model produced, thinking included
costBases.note: Leverage is computed and reported on each basis separately. No monetary basis: no versioned price evidence is admitted.

minimumPairsNote: 25 matched pairs is the initial broad-claim policy. The five-pair pilot produces an evaluation, never a published claim.
